item.description:
Release v5.13.0

Changes since v5.12.0

  • Add copyright © 2026 Coffic
  • feat: add Onboarding page localization and bundled sample project
  • feat: add shared landing page views for LLM provider, Open-in, and Theme families
  • feat: improve ProjectsPlugin ControlView with dropdown arrow, hover effects and animations
  • feat(AppLayout): Hide ActivityBar when only one view container exists
  • feat(ChatView): optimize UI display when no conversation selected
  • feat(conversation-list): hide redundant 'Current Project' scope when only one project exists
  • feat(ConversationList): Hide Current Project tab when project has no conversations
  • feat(ConversationListPlugin): dynamically control project-chats tab visibility
  • feat(ConversationManager): Implement conversationProjectCount API
  • feat(ConversationNewPlugin): 仅在有选中对话时显示新建会话按钮
  • feat(FactoryCore): Add RailBottomView with settings entry
  • feat(FactoryCore): bridge Settings window open via notification and replace polling with KernelBootstrapStatus
  • feat(KernelHosting): Add KernelBootstrapStatus for cross-window boot phase observation
  • feat(KernelLumi): Add openSettings notification and conversationProjectCount API
  • feat(KernelLumi): add Prompt Suggestion protocol and aggregation manager
  • feat(LumiUI): add Landing component suite
  • feat(LumiUI): Redesign color theme to forest-green palette and add Landing components
  • feat(message-list): add prompt suggestion chips to empty state
  • feat(MessageList): Add project switching and adding to empty state view
